title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 8. Points out that State aid is increasingly used to support industrial policy objectives; recalls that such aid, as permitted under Article 107(3)(c) TFEU, must not adversely affect trading conditions or the common interest; notes the divergent fiscal capabilities of the Member States and warns that fragmented State aid creates an uneven playing field; emphasises that a potential future European Competitiveness Fund should respect the sovereignty of Member States and cannot transfer competences to EU institutions, and should at the same time refrain from politically or ideologically driven conditionality; underlines that industrial policy and fiscal policy should remain a national competence and that subsidising policy through common debt risks fuelling further economic divergence and undermining democratic accountability;
